run_train: run the tactile SSL model training pipeline with Hydra config and WandB logging
run_get_dataloaders: run the dataloader creation function to build train and validation PyTorch DataLoaders from config
run_get_dataloaders_vision_based: run the vision-based dataloader builder for digit, gelsight_mini, and gelsight sensor types
run_get_dataloaders_magnetic_based: run the magnetic-based dataloader builder for tdex and reskin tactile sensor datasets
run_attempt_resume: run the checkpoint resume logic to restore a previous training run from SLURM or config
